chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who says to his wife, 'She is unto him like the back of his mother.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'The freeing of a neck, or fasting for two consecutive months, or feeding sixty poor people, and the freeing of a neck is sufficient for it a child who was born in Islam.'

key_terms.الزَّهَار: Liking the wife to the back of one's mother (a specific form of divorce/oath)

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for Zuhar in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the hierarchical expiation (kaffarah) for Zuhar, prioritizing the freeing of a slave before fasting or feeding the poor, reflecting the socio-economic realities of early Shia jurisprudence. It notably clarifies that a 'slave' (raqabah) can be a young child born to a slave woman within Islam, a specific nuance in Shia legal interpretation regarding manumission. This ruling is derived directly from Surah Al-Mujadila, establishing Zuhar as a major sin requiring specific remedial acts to restore marital harmony.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Muawiya Bin Wahab who said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man who is saying to his wife that she is unto him like the back of his mother. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should free a neck or Fast for two months consecutively, or feed sixty poor ones, and the freeing would suffice from it a child from the ones who were born in Al-Islam’.
en.sarwar: 22. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahab who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who says to his wife that she is like the back of his mother to him. He (the Imam) said, ‘The expiation for it is setting free of a slave or fasting for two consecutive months or feeding sixty destitute people. For freeing a slave, a child born in Islam is sufficient.’”
